results.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
results.overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia’s New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

results.title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
results.original_title: Le Journal d'une femme de chambre
results.overview: A young Romanian woman living in France works for a French family and joins a theatre company who are adapting Octave Mirbeau's The Diary of a Chambermaid.

results.title: Pansamantala
results.overview: A story of a drunken dare that pulls best friends into a sexy secret, sparking desire, guilt, and jealousy while testing how far friendship can go.

results.title: She Only Eats Meat
results.overview: Sofía and Minerva tackle their many problems in different ways - all at once. Too many issues and a talent for chaos turn their inner journey into a hilarious spectacle.

results.title: Balandrau: Where the Fierce Wind Blew
results.overview: On December 30, 2000, a group of friends climbed Balandrau, but an unpredictable blizzard unleashed the worst Pyrenees storm in history.

results.title: All Shades of Temptation
results.overview: In Lemberg (Lviv) in 1897, Amelia Kryzhevska-Zeg returns to the family estate where she grew up after her honeymoon. She is full of hope for the future and dreams of opening her own pharmacy. But gradually, her childhood home turns into a treacherous trap, and Amelia's plans become unfulfillable desires.

results.title: Earworm
results.overview: After spending all day in bed doomscrolling, Reed stumbles upon a video of a mother ‘unaliving’ her baby… while humming the same 4 notes over and over and over. Now every sound that Reed hears in his everyday life morphs into those 4 notes– and with each note, the bloody Mother draws closer.

results.title: The Lost Ones
results.overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

results.title: Rakkasapuradhol
results.overview: Inspector Shiva an alcoholic officer struggling with schizophrenia, is transferred to Rakkasapura, a seemingly quiet village with a low crime rate. Soon The village’s peace is shattered by a series of gruesome murders. Young women are found dead, dressed in bridal finery with their faces charred beyond recognition. Witness as a troubled cop in rural India confronts his own demons while pursuing a complex case that tests his moral boundaries and beliefs.

results.title: Flesh Impact
results.overview: A mysterious old woman auditions for a play at a small blackbox theater in New York City. As she describes her qualifications and her acting experience, secrets about her identity and the misconceptions about her life bubble to the surface.

results.title: Lenin
results.overview: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

results.title: Je m'appelle Agneta
results.overview: Craving a fresh start, recently unemployed Agneta accepts an au pair gig in Provence that turns into an indulgent escape — and an unexpected awakening.

results.title: Bride of the Year
results.overview: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

results.title: Sheep Eater
results.overview: A twenty something-year-old stoner, lost in heartbreak and uncertainty, drifts through the wreckage of adulthood. Caught between self-destruction and the hope of moving on with his life, Brad struggles to face the reality of growing up.

results.title: Murder in the Highland Manor
results.overview: Kate takes a job as a live-in tutor at a secluded Scottish estate for a mother and daughter who’ve escaped domestic abuse. But when she discovers the previous au pair mysteriously disappeared, Kate becomes embroiled in the family’s deadly secrets.

results.title: Na Willa
results.overview: A six-year-old girl who views her narrow Surabaya alley as a magical haven faces the bittersweet pain of growing up as her close friends drift away and her world begins to shrink.
